scope: Rotating kinematic cuboid and free dynamic sphere, exact signed-distance oracle, friction/restitution zero. Negative separation is penetration. Static support is the control. Driven energy is not conserved. Default motion is limited to 1.5 radians and 0.25s to avoid late speed-cap confounding; fullDuration is explicitly exploratory. Fresh native shape queries are checked against the independent oracle. Reported manifold-normal angle is an outer-step observation, not an internal Jacobian trace.
